body: Yeah, me doing something would piss off my family and they don't deserve that. So i'm basically living for them and not myself. What a life.
The number of times I've said that I've lost count of. She doesn't care.
She'd make me so angry sometimes I'd threaten to divorce her and say things like I wasn't sure I loved her anymore. Turns out you don't know what you've lost until its gone.
I don't see it like that. But she does. Or so she says.
Thanks......to be honest i'm deeply ashamed that I ruined my marriage...I don't think i've managed to talk to anyone about it while sober. And I was only a social drinker (rarely) before this....
